plugins.name: usage-trace
plugins.description: Trace keyword usage, call chains, and database tables in Java/Spring, Python, or C# with an offline HTML report, plus a field-regression pipeline. Auto-trigger for prompts like 分析当前项目的 orderId, 查找字段使用情况, 追踪调用链, 字段流向, 生成字段用例, 字段回归, 打通上线SQL.
